content.text:
The bug was an off-by-one in `src/offset.js`, and all 4 tests pass now.

The README and tests number pages from 1, but `offset` calculated `page * perPage`, which only works if pages start at 0. That meant `pageOf(1)` skipped the five newest issues and returned `[7, 6, 5, 4, 3]` instead of `[12, 11, 10, 9, 8]`, and `pageOf(3)` came back empty instead of `[2, 1]`.

I changed it to `(page - 1) * perPage`. `offset` is only used by `src/page.js`, so nothing else is affected.
